zh|ja|d0ee9234099e2795bca6.text: 当被问及引入人工智能代理的效果时，许多管理者无法将节省的时间转化为金钱。投资回报率可以通过从实施获得的收益中减去总成本并除以总成本来计算。然而，人工智能代理的成本每次执行时都会发生变化，因此与传统 SaaS 相同的估算将导致不同的数字。如果在实施前没有测量数字就继续实施，您将无法证明其有效性，并且您的预算将被削减。一旦了解了计算公式和成本明细，您就可以创建可直接用于审批的试算。

en|ja|01f6c7d80f718314377d.text: Explaining how to calculate ROI of AI agent! From calculation formulas and KPI design to trial calculation examples

en|ja|d0ee9234099e2795bca6.text: When asked about the effects of introducing an AI agent, many managers are unable to convert the time saved into monetary terms. ROI can be calculated by subtracting the total cost from the benefits obtained from implementation and dividing by the total cost. However, the cost of AI agents changes each time they are executed, so the same estimates as traditional SaaS will result in different numbers. If you proceed without measuring the numbers before implementation, you will not be able to demonstrate the effectiveness and your budget will be cut off. Once you understand the calculation formula and cost breakdown, you can create a trial calculation that can be used directly for approval.

zh|ja|fb44017cade55de67ba4.text: 利用人工智能代理进行人力资源和招聘！四项可以自动化的任务以及需要记住的事项

zh|ja|d2babc06e2d49a7f8406.text: 除了招聘之外，有很多负责人觉得自己无法胜任核心的人力资源职责，因为他们加入公司后要负责处理询问。人工智能代理是一种可以自主执行日常任务的人工智能，例如调整时间表和响应查询。另一方面，最终的通过/失败判断和评估必须由人类来做出。在这篇文章中，我们将解释人力资源和招聘中可以自动化的任务、好处、注意事项以及实施的3个步骤。读完这本书，你将能够理清留给公司的任务和留给别人的决定，并能够决定第一步。

en|ja|fb44017cade55de67ba4.text: Utilize AI agents for human resources and recruitment! Four tasks that can be automated and things to keep in mind

en|ja|d2babc06e2d49a7f8406.text: In addition to recruiting, there are many people in charge who feel that they are unable to handle the core human resources duties because they are responsible for handling inquiries after joining the company. An AI agent is an AI that can autonomously perform routine tasks such as adjusting schedules and responding to inquiries. On the other hand, the final judgment of pass/fail and evaluation must be made by humans. In this article, we will explain the tasks that can be automated in human resources and recruitment, the benefits, points to note, and the 3 steps for implementation. After reading this book, you will be able to sort out the tasks that will be left to your company and the decisions that will be left to others, and will be able to decide on the first step.

zh|ja|970152a429342ae49180.text: 什么是AI面试官？向人力资源部门解释实施程序、工具比较和成本

zh|ja|db924dfa06ce43942e11.text: 随着申请数量的增加，HR面临着安排和进行初次面试的负担，您是否担心面试官的评价不一致？一种解决方案是人工智能面试官，人工智能负责一些提问和评估。但是，如果在没有确定要委托给AI的范围及其运行规则的情况下引入AI，那么在向候选人的解释和个人信息的处理方面将无法达成内部共识。在本文中，我们将在了解人工智能面试官的机制后，根据官方信息，讲解如何选择服务、大概费用、实施流程以及人力资源应遵循的操作规则。

en|ja|970152a429342ae49180.text: What is an AI interviewer? Explaining implementation procedures, tool comparisons, and costs for HR

en|ja|db924dfa06ce43942e11.text: As the number of applications increases, HR is burdened with scheduling and conducting initial interviews, and are you worried about the disparity in evaluations among interviewers? One solution is an AI interviewer, in which AI is responsible for some of the questioning and evaluation. However, if you introduce AI without determining the scope of what you want to entrust to AI and its operational rules, you will not be able to reach internal consensus regarding explanations to candidates and the handling of personal information. In this article, we will explain how to choose a service, approximate fees, implementation procedures, and operational rules that human resources should follow, based on official information, after understanding the mechanism of AI interviewers.
